meta.source: Iris theme of the SpecWithCode app (packages/shared/src/themePalettes.ts), tuned for long-form web pages

tokens.name: wv-canvas
tokens.usage: Page ground on every site. Cool, faintly violet neutral taken from the Iris canvas.

tokens.name: wv-panel
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces that are real objects: a window frame, a menu, a skill row on hover. Never a decorative card.

tokens.name: wv-sunken
tokens.usage: Code blocks, command lines and inset wells.

tokens.name: wv-ink
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on wv-canvas, wv-panel, wv-sunken and wv-iris-tint (14:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: wv-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, metadata on any surface (5.1:1 or better).

tokens.name: wv-line
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows and around frames. Decorative only; never the sole border of a control.

tokens.name: wv-control
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, secondary buttons and checkboxes (3:1 on canvas and panel).

tokens.name: wv-iris
tokens.usage: The accent. Primary button fill, links, focus ring, the thread line, the current item. Text in iris reads 5:1 or better on every surface.

tokens.name: wv-iris-strong
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of iris; iris text on wv-iris-tint.

tokens.name: wv-iris-tint
tokens.usage: Selected row, highlighted step, the active product in the family bar.

tokens.name: wv-on-iris
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a wv-iris fill (6:1 or better).

tokens.name: wv-pass
tokens.usage: A check that passed: scan clean, source verified, tests green. Always paired with a word.

tokens.name: wv-pass-tint
tokens.usage: Ground of a pass chip.

tokens.name: wv-warn
tokens.usage: A check that needs a look: medium findings, stale data, usage near a limit.

tokens.name: wv-warn-tint
tokens.usage: Ground of a warn chip.

tokens.name: wv-fail
tokens.usage: A check that failed or a blocked skill. Always paired with a word and an icon.

tokens.name: wv-fail-tint
tokens.usage: Ground of a fail chip.

tokens.name: wv-brand-tile
tokens.usage: The SpecWithCode app icon tile only. Not a UI color.

families.mono: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: wv-display
styles.usage: One per page, the hero line. 44px under 640px wide.

styles.name: wv-h1
styles.sample: Hand off without losing your place
styles.usage: Page titles that are not a hero. 36px on phones.

styles.name: wv-h2
styles.sample: What a verified skill has been through
styles.usage: Section headings. Left aligned, sentence case, no label above.

styles.name: wv-lead
styles.sample: Plan the work in a spec, let any agent do it, and keep the record in git.
styles.usage: The one paragraph under a hero or section heading. Max 60 characters per line.

styles.name: wv-body
styles.sample: When Claude Code hits its limit, Codex picks up the same task from the ledger.
styles.usage: Running text on marketing pages and docs. Max 72 characters per line.

styles.name: wv-ui
styles.usage: Buttons, navigation, table cells, form labels.

styles.name: wv-caption
styles.usage: Metadata, figure captions, footnotes. Never uppercase.

styles.name: wv-code
styles.usage: Commands, file names, paths, ids. Mono is for real code only, never for labels or headings.

tokens.name: wv-space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label, chip padding block.

tokens.name: wv-space-2
tokens.usage: Inside chips and compact rows.

tokens.name: wv-space-3
tokens.usage: Button padding block, row gaps.

tokens.name: wv-space-4
tokens.usage: Phone side gutter, button padding inline, paragraph gap.

tokens.name: wv-space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between a heading and its body; grid gutter on phones.

tokens.name: wv-space-8
tokens.usage: Desktop side gutter, grid gutter.

tokens.name: wv-space-12
tokens.usage: Between groups inside a section.

tokens.name: wv-space-16
tokens.usage: Section padding on phones.

tokens.name: wv-space-24
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop.

tokens.name: wv-space-32
tokens.usage: Above and below the hero on desktop.

tokens.name: wv-radius-xs
tokens.usage: Chips, kbd keys, inline code.

tokens.name: wv-radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, the family bar pills.

tokens.name: wv-radius-md
tokens.usage: Code blocks, menus, note boxes.

tokens.name: wv-radius-lg
tokens.usage: Window frames around real screenshots. The largest radius in the system.

tokens.name: wv-shadow-window
tokens.usage: Only on a window frame holding a real screenshot.

tokens.name: wv-shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, the command palette.

tokens.name: wv-measure
tokens.usage: Max width of running text.

tokens.name: wv-page-max
tokens.usage: Max width of the page grid.

tokens.name: wv-thread-width
tokens.usage: Stroke of the thread line that connects steps and layers.

tokens.name: wv-duration-ui
tokens.usage: Color and border transitions on links, buttons and controls. Written literally in weave.css today.

tokens.name: wv-ease-ui
tokens.usage: Easing for UI transitions.

tokens.name: wv-scroll-range
tokens.usage: Default animation-range for the first step of a scroll sequence driven by view(); later steps end a few percent later. Use only inside @supports (animation-timeline: view()) and prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference; the resting state is the final state.
